title: Only Shaytan Causes Dissension and Fighting
body:
Because the people from the middle of Europe, i.e., Hungary, Czechoslovakia, Romania and Ukraine, all of
their men are very handsome and their ladies are first class.
A`oodhu billahi min ash-Shaytaani ‘r-rajeem. Bismillahi 'r-Rahmaani 'r-Raheem.
(Bay`a) Allahuma thabitna `ala ’l-haqq, allahuma thabitna `ala ’l-haqq, allahuma thatbitna `alal Haqq.
Fatihah.
Mubarak! Congratulations! The Lord of Heavens, Allah the Creator, is only One. He created Man and made
them into different nations and gave every nation a khusoosiyat, speciality. You (Ukrainian) have a speciality,
he is Russian, he has a speciality and he (Chechen) has a speciality. There is only one Lord and countless
servants, and all of us are only servants. We have been created to be the Lord’s servants.
But people are leaving that and they fight, because there is one, Shaytan, the devil, who is making people to
be enemies. This is a big world and it is enough for all Mankind, but people are coming all together and
fighting. It is not the truth! The Lord of Heavens likes His servants to live peacefully, not to quarrel or fight.
But what shall we say?

Adam (a) had two sons, and Shaytan made enmity between the two brothers. The first killing on Earth was
when Qabeel killed his brother, and still it is going on. The place where Qabeel killed Habeel is in Damascus
on the mountain. I was looking and seeing that the blood of Habeel is running in that cave on that holy
mountain; there are two rocks crying for Habil from that time up to now.
Beginning from that time, Shaytan has always made people sorry. A brother kills a brother and tribes kill
tribes, nations kill other nations, and for what? One person from Germany, Hitler, followed Shaytan and he
killed millions of people! Shaytan is always killing, perhaps hundreds of millions of people. Look at what
Mussolini did. When WWII was beginning, I was (young) like you in 1939, finishing my secondary school at
that time, then boom! Perhaps 500 million people were killed, for what? Shaytan (is always) preparing us to
kill each other. I am sorry, but we can’t do anything.
I am saying, “O my Lord! Send us someone from Heavens to stop people from fighting and killing and doing
bad things. Jesus Christ (a) is coming, and from Muslims, Mahdi (a) is coming to keep people from fighting.
Now what shall we do? We can’t do anything. I am only asking Peel Meen (soup). (laughter) You know Peel
Meen? He (guest) is a good one. He is from real Russians, their grandfathers belong to Csars... five
generations up, and these are noble people. Mashaa-Allah.
But people are now like this (upside down), so what shall we do? Welcome to you! I am accepting you. If I
have been granted something from the Lord of Heavens to save people, I am going to do that. To see you once
is enough for me. May Allah forgive me. Give him my soup. What shall we do? Happy life for you, sweet life
for you here and Paradise in the Hereafter. (Thank you very much). O my friend!
